name: My Fluffy Neighbor: Moonfall Festival
source:
In this Halloween spinoff to My Fluffy Neighbor, trade the crowded town festivities for a cozy camping adventure under the harvest moon! When your friend Amber suggests celebrating the Moonfall Festival differently this year, you and five friends venture into the forest for a night of campfire stories, festive costumes, and quality time together.

Set up camp, share spooky tales around the fire, enjoy good food and drinks, and watch as the harvest moon rises over the trees! Your choices will shape how the night unfolds as you create memories with familiar faces and maybe even encounter something unexpected (and spooky) along the way.

[From [url=https://invisiblecactus.itch.io/my-fluffy-neighbor-moonfall-festival]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在《我的毛茸茸的邻居》的这部万圣节衍生剧中，用拥挤的城镇庆祝活动来换取丰收月下舒适的露营冒险！当你的朋友安布尔建议今年以不同的方式庆祝中秋节时，你和五个朋友冒险进入森林，度过一个篝火故事之夜，穿着节日服装，共度美好时光。

扎营，围着火分享恐怖故事，享受美食和饮料，并观看丰收的月亮从树林中升起！当你与熟悉的面孔一起创造回忆时，你的选择将决定夜晚的展开方式，甚至可能在途中遇到一些意想不到的（和恐怖的）事情。

[来自[url=https://invisiblecactus.itch.io/my-fluffy-neighbor-moonfall-festival]itch.io[/url]]
